summary: 太祖嫡长孙，天眷改制颁汉官制，皇统元年与宋绍兴和议；晚年诛戮无度，为海陵所弑。
summary_en: Eldest grandson of Taizu, he issued the Chinese-style official system in the Tianjuan reforms and made the Shaoxing Treaty with Song; his later years of indiscriminate killing ended in assassination by Hailing.

timeline.title: 生
timeline.summary: 太祖嫡长孙，宗峻之子，幼习汉文经史。
timeline.summary_en: Eldest grandson of Taizu, schooled in Chinese classics from youth.

timeline.title: 官制汉化
timeline.summary: 改官制、用汉仪、颁新字，设尚书省六部，汉式官僚体系确立。
timeline.summary_en: He reformed the official system, adopted Han ceremonial, issued new script, and set up the Six Ministries, establishing a Chinese-style bureaucracy.

timeline.title: 绍兴和议
timeline.summary: 皇统元年与宋和议，宋称臣、划淮为界。
timeline.summary_en: The Shaoxing Treaty of 1141 made Song a vassal along the Huai.

timeline.title: 被弑
timeline.summary: 晚年纵酒诛戮，皇统九年为完颜亮所弑。
timeline.summary_en: Drinking and killing in his last years, he was assassinated by Wanyan Liang in 1149.

timeline.title: 熙宗总评
timeline.summary: 始学汉法而终失其度，一代制度成而一代之君亡。
timeline.summary_en: He began the Han institutions and lost his own measure; the system outlived the sovereign.

bio_md:
# 金熙宗完颜亶 · 主要事迹

完颜亶（1119—1149），[[jin-tai-zu|太祖]]嫡长孙，天会十三年（1135）[[jin-tai-zong|太宗]]崩后继位。

熙宗自幼习汉文经史，即位后推行汉化：天眷元年（1138）颁行新官制，设尚书省六部，汉式官僚体系确立；皇统元年（1141）与南宋订「绍兴和议」，宋称臣、划淮为界、岁贡银绢各二十五万，宋金对峙格局自此定型。

熙宗后期纵酒滥杀，诛戮宗室大臣无度，朝野震恐。皇统九年（1149）十二月，完颜亮弑帝自立，是为[[jin-hailiing|海陵王]]。
